theme_and_archetype.description: A modern government service aesthetic. Utilitarian, highly readable, trustworthy. Normal mode is calm and clean. Emergency mode shifts dramatically with aggressive warning colors (Red/Orange) to signal urgency. Understandable in 3 seconds.

rules.headings: Bold (700) or ExtraBold (800) for high impact. Tight tracking (tracking-tight) for large headers.
rules.body: Regular (400) or Medium (500) for readable lists and cards. Clear line height (leading-relaxed).
rules.labels: Uppercase, tracking-widest, text-xs or text-sm for status badges and overlines.

scale.h1_emergency: text-4xl sm:text-5xl font-extrabold tracking-tighter text-white uppercase

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous spacing. Big touch targets. Zero visual clutter.
spacing_and_layout.containers: max-w-md mx-auto w-full (for mobile app feel on web).
spacing_and_layout.cards: p-6 sm:p-8 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white shadow-sm
spacing_and_layout.buttons: Large tap areas (min-h-[56px] or h-14), rounded-xl, full width on mobile.
spacing_and_layout.grids: grid-cols-1 gap-4 for lists, gap-6 for major sections.

Button.primary: bg-slate-900 text-white hover:bg-slate-800 h-14 rounded-xl font-bold text-lg
Button.emergency_trigger: bg-red-600 text-white hover:bg-red-700 h-16 rounded-2xl font-black text-xl uppercase tracking-wider shadow-lg animate-pulse-slow
Button.status_action_safe: bg-green-600 text-white hover:bg-green-700 h-20 rounded-2xl font-bold text-2xl shadow-md
Button.status_action_help: bg-red-600 text-white hover:bg-red-700 h-20 rounded-2xl font-bold text-2xl shadow-md
Button.status_action_away: bg-blue-600 text-white hover:bg-blue-700 h-16 rounded-2xl font-bold text-xl shadow-md

Card.default: bg-white rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm p-6
Card.emergency_header: bg-red-600 rounded-b-3xl text-white pt-12 pb-8 px-6 shadow-md

StatusBadge.base: inline-flex items-center px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider

Normal_Home.header: White background, minimal logo, user profile.
Normal_Home.content: Next drill date, assigned assembly point (e.g., 'Point A - Main Parking').

Emergency_Alert.header: Full width deep red banner. Large text: 'EMERGENCY ALERT'.
Emergency_Alert.content: Three massive buttons taking up the screen. 1. I AM SAFE (Green). 2. I NEED HELP (Red). 3. NOT AT LOCATION (Blue).

Firewatch_Dashboard.vibe: Command center, high data density but clear grouping.
Firewatch_Dashboard.content: Top summary stats (X Safe, Y Pending, Z Needs Help). Filterable list of members grouped by status (Red first, then Orange, then Green). Large 'End Alert' button.

motion_and_interaction.hover_states: Buttons must have explicit hover and active states (e.g., active:scale-95).
motion_and_interaction.animations: Use subtle pulsing (animate-pulse) for the 'Pending' status icon or 'Start Emergency' button to draw attention.

image_urls.description: Large brick building with dark roof
image_urls.category: Admin Organization Cover Image (Vilnius Logistics Center)

media.icons: Use lucide-react. Keep icons minimal and bold (e.g., ShieldAlert, CheckCircle, AlertTriangle). No thin or decorative icons.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the status color hexes provided for all badges and buttons.
Do not use generic Inter font for headings; use Work Sans.
Ensure 'Not confirmed safe' is used instead of 'Missing'.
Design mobile-first. If on web, constrain the main app view to max-w-md or max-w-lg to mimic a mobile app.
Include data-testid on all buttons and cards.
In the Emergency view, use a heavy red header that clearly breaks the normal white/grey UI pattern.
